name: oasis-browser
description: OASIS Browser - Multi-Account Isolated Profile Platform
author: OASIS Team

scripts.start:emulators: OASIS_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=1 npx --yes firebase-tools@15.24.0 emulators:exec --project oasis-local --only auth,firestore,functions "electron ."
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.24.0 emulators:exec --project oasis-rules-test --only firestore "node tests/firestore-rules.emulator.js"
scripts.test:functions: npm ci --prefix functions --ignore-scripts && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.24.0 emulators:exec --project oasis-functions-test --only auth,firestore,functions "node tests/functions-emulator.e2e.js"
scripts.test:syntax: node --check src/config/firebase.js && node --check src/config/backend.js && node --check src/main/backend/provider.js && node --check src/main/backend/firebase-provider.js && node --check src/main/backend/selfhosted-provider.js && node --check src/main/index.js && node --check src/main/auth-manager.js && node --check src/main/sync-manager.js && node --check src/main/browser-launcher.js && node --check functions/index.js
scripts.verify: npm run test:syntax && npm test && npm audit --package-lock-only --omit=dev
scripts.release: node scripts/extract-release-notes.js && GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token 2>/dev/null || echo $GH_TOKEN) electron-builder --mac --win --publish always
